intent.premise: A sixty-second clear-summer-night healing short in the flat sunprint style (night variant: deep indigo-to-violet sky, flat star dots and a crescent moon, cool blue-silver moonlight rim, sparse warm door/window lamps, flat yellow-green firefly dots): on the same night after the dusk homecoming, the orange tabby calls from the wall top and leads the girl out through the night lane and over the stone bridge to the riverbank, where fireflies rise around them, told through approved 2D keyframes, 2D crop moves, four seedance-2.0-mini image-to-video clips played as 12fps cel sequences for the continuous-action shots (cat night wall walk, girl night bridge walk, cat night bank run, girl night bank walk), procedural flat-shape sunprint layers (star twinkle, moonlight river band, firefly drift, door-lamp pool), energy-gated Chinese viseme cels for the girl's inner monologue, and a gentle night score that lifts at the final line. All travel is screen-right (night outing, same direction as E01/E02).
intent.audience: Viewers evaluating a compact but complete 2D anime short with a stable generated heroine, a consistent orange tabby cat, a readable home-to-lane-to-bridge-to-riverbank night progression, and synchronized sound.
designPriorities: Keep the girl's waist-length dark-blue hair, amber eyes, white shirt, and navy plaid pleated skirt stable across every frame; no umbrella, no school bag.
Keep the orange tabby cat's white chest, white paws, and green eyes stable; it is dry and fluffy after the previous episode's rescue.
Use hard cuts for all beats so character and cat silhouettes never double through a dissolve; reserve the single closing crossfade for the final sky tilt-out shot.

Gate visible closed, half, and open mouth cels at 12 fps from the exact post-trim final dialogue stem, then select limited visemes from the known Chinese syllables, never from subtitle duration; cat meows are gated from the SFX-only cue entries 4, 11 and 16.
Derive frame selection, mouth state, crop motion, transitions, and subtitles only from absolute story time so seeks and segmented renders remain deterministic.

Draw every procedural layer (star twinkle, moonlight river band, firefly drift, door light band) as razor-clean flat vector shapes in source-image space; zero grain, zero gradients, per STYLE_BIBLE.md.

intent.location: A night lane home entrance with a warm door lamp, a night residential lane with a white walkable perimeter wall, a small stone bridge over the moonlit river, and a night riverbank with grassy slope under a starry sky, all baked into full-frame 2D artwork plus four baked-motion I2V cel sequences; fireflies are a programmatic layer, never baked into masters.
intent.timeOfDay: Clear summer night about 9pm: deep indigo-to-violet sky, flat star dots and a crescent moon, cool blue-silver moonlight rim, sparse warm-yellow door and window lamps.
intent.storyFunction: Follow the cat leading the girl out at night: from the lamplit front door, along the night lane, over the stone bridge, to the riverbank where fireflies rise, closing on her asking the cat to keep taking her to new places.
visualRules: Every source PNG fills the 1920 by 1080 presentation canvas through cover-crop without aspect-ratio distortion.
The keyframe timeline, rather than equal frame division, determines every image boundary and camera-like crop move.
Each spoken line keeps one stable speaker plate; only a tight mouth rectangle changes between closed, half, and open states.
Chinese subtitles are rendered in code over text-free source art and must remain inside the lower safe area.
The scene uses a CanvasTexture as the Three.js background, so runtime camera collision geometry is intentionally inapplicable and camera obstacles remain empty.
Girl is a voice-only story speaker whose visible body is baked into the keyframes; no 3D character meshes may be layered over the artwork.
No runtime grain, noise, or texture layer may be composited over the sunprint artwork.
Fireflies and star twinkle are deterministic time-driven programmatic flat-dot layers; masters and keyframes stay free of baked light dots.

purpose: Represent the full-frame timed 2D presentation rather than a navigable 3D stage.

screenCenter.purpose: Stable center of the full-frame keyframe canvas.

bakedHomeDoor.purpose: Semantic screen-left lamplit front door where the night outing begins, represented inside the generated artwork.

bakedRiverbankSlope.purpose: Semantic screen-right riverbank slope area used by the closing firefly sit-together shots, represented inside the generated artwork.

lighting.mood: Quiet clear-summer-night flat color: deep indigo sky, cool blue-silver moonlight rims, sparse warm door/window lamps, warm yellow-green firefly dots.
readabilityRules: Do not apply runtime lighting or grading that changes character colors between generated frames.
Keep faces, the navy and white costume silhouette, and the orange cat readable against the darker night plates during all crop motion and transitions.
Keep subtitle contrast independent of the baked background by using a dark translucent backing and outlined white text.

audioAnchors.semantic: Summer-night cricket bed and faint night wind over the whole episode, thickening toward the riverbank.
Night lane and stone-bridge footsteps while the girl follows the cat; cat meows at the wall top and bridge-end beats.
River water and night wind beds from the bridge reveal to the end; grass footsteps on the slope.

shotChecks.purpose: Confirm the night lane home entrance, door lamp and starry sky fill the first frame with subtitle-safe margins.
Confirm the girl peeking out of the front door is readable during the first monologue line with syllable-aware visemes.
Confirm the I2V cat-night-wall-walk cel sequence is playing (mid-clip frame differs from the first frame).
Confirm the girl begins the final firefly line on camera with syllable-aware visemes before the warm pull-out.
